premises.text: Construction wastes large shares of materials through paper-based, error-prone measurement and execution workflows
premises.evidence_span: almost 20% of materials on a given job site being completely wasted and in the dumpster

premises.text: A connected hardware and software ecosystem captures, shares, annotates, and turns measurements into tasks without paper steps
premises.evidence_span: connected ecosystem of hardware and software products to significantly reduce these errors

premises.text: The Rock Jobsite mobile app consolidates measurement capture, calculators, and plan-related workflows for workers
premises.evidence_span: The Rock Jobsite app is a simple and easy to use platform that works on any mobile device

premises.text: Digital jobsite tools (tape measure, saw caliper, QR labels) capture and execute measurements and link them into the app
premises.evidence_span: the T1 Tomahawk really represents the core of our hardware ecosystem

premises.text: Every worker on site, not only supervisors, can use the equipment and app
premises.evidence_span: every worker on the job site can use the equipment

domains.name: connected Rock app and digital tools

value.text: Jobsite measurement and execution with far fewer avoidable errors and material waste
value.evidence_span: significantly reduce these errors and streamline operations on the job site

causal_links.evidence_span: over $100 billion wasted in construction each year
eliminating many of the human touch points in the process

notes: T1/M1/QR devices folded into one hardware-tools premise as facets of the connected measurement ecosystem; Rock app kept separate as the software hub. Two-domain partition (problem vs connected system) rather than a need/product/money triad.
